title: PWA / Mobile Web MVP Polish
completionDefinition: Phase 8B polished the local mobile-first React Web / PWA shell with manifest metadata, mobile home, PWA readiness, MVP polish readiness, Chinese copy, and administrator QA separation.

8B did not implement the production user app, backend, database, accounts, analytics, service worker, offline cache, push notification, background sync, install tracking, camera, AR, training, OpenAI API, external APIs, native iOS, React Native, Flutter, ecommerce, community, paid features, app store release work, online publication, or new runtime dependencies.
8B did not bootstrap a separate production app repository.
Makeup Engine must remain the template production system and UserAppTemplatePackage must remain the handoff contract.
Docs and project-state must remain recoverable and validation commands must pass.
Tests passed and validation commands pass before 8B completion is accepted.
dependsOn: 8A Product Route Decision / App MVP Planning
